description: Temporary change of use of the park for the staging of a number of musical events between 6th September and 8th September 2019. Erection of associated temporary structures.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The event is permitted between 30th August 2019 and 13th September 2019 inclusive of site construction and demolition.

Condition : 2 - The proposed eventshall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Transport Assessment, Design and Access Statement, Gunnersbury Park Conservation Management Plan (Issue 08), Structures Key and List, Draft Noise Management Plan, Environmental Statement, Flood Risk Assessment, unnumbered tent elevations, and drawings 19/05/24 and 19/05/25 [Received 30th May 2019]. Transport Assessment (Further Information), Event Risk Assessment (V1), Production Schedule (V1) and Ingress and Egress Plan [Received 23rd July 2019]. Event Site & Access  Routes V2.dwg (Version 10) [Received 12th August 2019]. Traffic, Transport & Pedestrian Management Plan (1.3) [Received 19th August 2019]. Events Management Plan (V.3), Sound Management Plan (NMP_rev2_190710), Appendix A (Flow Rates) and Notes on Ingress Plan [Received 20th August 2019]. Location Plan 19/05/21(Rev.F), Taxi Route Map and Letter, Appendices B and C.1-4 [Received 22nd August 2019]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the event is implemented.
Condition : 3 - The musical events shall be managed in accordance with the submitted Events Management Plan (V.3) of 31 July 2019 (as amended).

Condition : 4 - The construction/derigging works associated with the event shall be carried out in accordance with the submitted Production Schedule, Transport Assessment and associated documents and the Events Management Plan (V.3).

Condition : 5 - Prior to the commencement of the use, the proposed cycle storage for at least 50 cycles shall be installed and made available for use. The spaces shall be available throughout the duration of the event.

Condition : 6 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 8pm Monday to Sunday.  Noisy works (defined as works which can be heard outside the boundary of the park) shall only take place between 8am to 6pm on Mondays to Sunday. 
No vehicle movements shall take place outside of the hours 0800 to 2000 Monday - Sunday.

Condition : 7 - The delivery and servicing arrangements associated with the event shall be carried out in accordance with the measures outlined in the submitted Production Schedule, Transport Assessment and associated documents and Events Management Plan (V.3).

Condition : 8 - The floodlighting hereby approved shall only be operational 0800-23.30 and turned off at all other times, except for that required for security and safety purposes.  Floodlighting will take into consideration the location of and proximity to local residential premises.

Condition : 9 - The uses and structures hereby approved shall only be open to the public at the following times for the duration of the permission:
"	Friday 6th September: 15:30-22:30
"	Saturday 7th September: 15:30-22:30
"	Sunday 8th September: 12:30-22:15

Condition : 10 - (a)	Prior to any on site works commencing, a photo record and site conditions report and a remediation strategy (which demonstrates how the site will be returned to its pre-event state as a minimum) shall be submitted to the Council
(b)	Following the conclusion of the events hereby approved, the applicant shall complete the necessary remediation to return the land  to the condition identified in part (a) of this condition (save for any wear and tear as identified in the lease agreement).
(c)	Evidence of the site restoration as outlined in part (b) of this condition shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority within 1 month of the removal of the structures hereby approved.

Condition : 11 - The event shall be carried out in accordance with the protocol outlined in the Noise Management Protocol, or such other protocol as agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority, and shall be carried out in accordance with the details set out in the submitted Sound Management Plan.
